_help: Edit freely, the tracker rescans history by itself after a change. Tool calls go to the FIRST skill whose rule matches (so put specific rules above general ones). A prompt counts once per skill whose rule matches. prompt kinds: turn (a new message), midturn (sent while the agent works), interrupt (you pressed stop).

skills.name: Prompting
skills.about: New messages you write. Longer prompts earn a little more.

skills.name: Steering
skills.about: Course corrections: messages sent mid-turn and interrupts.

skills.name: Planning
skills.about: Plan mode and questions the agent puts to you.

skills.name: AFK Coding
skills.about: Minutes your agents work on their own between your messages.

skills.name: Ultracode
skills.about: Workflow runs and ultracode / ultra review prompts.

skills.name: Delegation
skills.about: Subagents, side sessions and messages between agents.

skills.name: Research
skills.about: Web search, page fetches, browsers and docs lookups.

skills.name: Testing
skills.about: Test runs: pytest, make test/check, npm test, vitest, playwright...

skills.name: Artistry
skills.about: Artifacts, docs, charts and files sent to you.

skills.name: Connecting
skills.about: Calls to other MCP servers (data, APIs, services).
